list.confirmDeactivateMsg: Deactivate {{username}}? They will not be able to sign in.
list.confirmDeleteMsg: Delete {{username}}? This action cannot be undone.
list.reactivateMsg: Reactivate {{username}}? They will be able to sign in again.
list.forceDeleteMessage: {{username}} has linked history (tickets, letters, comments, movements, etc.) that normally blocks deletion. form.descriptionNew: Create a new account for the team
form.heading: System account
form.headingHint: Set identity, access and organizational location.
form.name: First name
form.passwordEditHint: When editing, leave the password blank to keep it.
form.extraRolesHint: Besides the primary role, this person can have other roles. Their permissions are the union of all of them (the widest scope wins).

permissions.title: This person's permissions
permissions.subtitle: Beyond what the role grants, you can raise, lower or remove a permission for this person only. The exception replaces the role.
permissions.dialogIntro: The {{scope}} scope will apply to this person only.

GENERIC.title: Custom role
GENERIC.summary: Role created from the Roles and permissions screen. What it can do depends on the permissions the administrator granted.
actions: Its scope is defined by the role's permissions
The administrator tunes it in Roles and permissions

ADMIN.title: System Administrator
ADMIN.summary: Full control of catalogs, users, devices, tickets and reports.
actions: Configures permissions and users
Manages all departments
Can complete and close tasks

MANAGER.title: Manager
MANAGER.summary: Oversees tickets and tasks in their department.
actions: Creates and manages tickets
Assigns owners and tasks
Can complete tasks and close tickets

AREA_HEAD.title: Area head
AREA_HEAD.summary: Provides operational follow-up on their department's tickets.
actions: Creates tickets
Can generate tasks from their tickets
Moves assigned tasks to review

EMPLOYEE.title: Employee
EMPLOYEE.summary: Carries out assigned tasks and reports progress.
actions: Creates tickets to report issues
Only sees tickets with assigned tasks
Moves their tasks to review

HUMAN_RESOURCES.title: Human Resources
HUMAN_RESOURCES.summary: Manages the full personnel record (medical, official, contact data and documents).
actions: Views and edits the Personnel record
Uploads and manages personnel documents
Does not manage tickets, inventory or users

CHEF.title: Chef
CHEF.summary: Manages the kitchen store: items, lots, stock in, consumption and waste.
actions: Manages the kitchen store (minimums, maximums and expiry)
Records stock in, consumption and waste
Views the tickets of their area

GUARD.title: Guard
GUARD.summary: Runs the gatehouse from the app: scans staff credentials and records their entry or exit.
actions: Scans credentials and records entries/exits in the app
Sees their own records for the day
Does not see personnel records, inventory or users

form.guideStart: Fill in the person's details. If the username, email or employee number already exists, I'll tell you right away.
form.guideFix: Review the fields marked in red before saving.

hints.name: Type the first name. It shows in lists and on the clock.
hints.secondName: Middle name, if the person has one. You can leave it empty.
hints.email: The person's email. Used for the registration notice; I check it is not already taken.
hints.employeeNumber: Employee number. It is unique and the clock uses it to identify the person.
hints.username: Username used to sign in. It must be unique; I check it is free.
hints.role: Main role: defines what they can see and do. Permissions can be fine-tuned later without changing the role.
hints.password: Initial password. At least 6 characters; the person can change it later.
hints.usernameFree: That username is free: you can use it.

form.ready: All set! Review the details and create the user.

import.description: The file must include the columns "Employee Name", "Username" and "Password" in the first sheet. All users are created with the Employee role and no department assigned (you assign it later for each one).
